title: Knowledge Map
subtitle: A tree of topics linked to documents, articles, and wiki spaces.
noPermissionBody: You need the knowledge_map:read permission to view the Knowledge Map.
treeEmptyHintWriter: Use New node to add a root or narrower node. Choose “None (top-level)” for a root entry.
treeEmptyHintReader: An editor with knowledge_map:write can add terms to the map here.
deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}” and nested terms? Refer-to mappings are removed. This cannot be undone.
detailPlaceholderNoTree: Add terms to the map to select one and manage refer-tos.
detailSelectPrompt: Select a term in the map to see its path, notes, and which channels or wiki spaces refer to it.
referToIntro: This node can refer to many document channels, article channels, and wiki spaces—add each one below and it appears in the table. The same channel or wiki space can only be linked to one node at a time; saving here moves that link from another node if needed. Article channel IDs match the sidebar (mock data until a backend exists).
noReferTosYet: This term has no refer-tos yet.
toastSelectTermFirst: Select a term in the tree first.
toastChooseResource: Choose a resource to refer to.
exploreGraphEmpty: Add at least one term in the tree to open the graph.
exploreGraphHint: Choose a term to focus it on this map; choose a resource to open that channel, wiki, or articles.
explore3dEmpty: Add at least one node in the tree to open the 3D view.
mapHtmlDesignerComposerHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter new line
overviewStaleBanner: The map changed. Redesign and publish again if needed.
overviewSynthesizedBanner: Automatic layout — publish when you are ready.
overviewUnresolvedBanner: {{count}} references in the layout no longer match the map.
overviewEmptySections: Nothing here yet. Add terms on Edit map.
overviewA2uiRenderFailed: Could not show this overview. Try again, or reset to automatic layout.
overviewDesignerSubtitle: Chat to reshape the overview layout.
overviewDesignerDeleteChatConfirm: Delete this chat and all of its messages? This cannot be undone.
overviewDesignerNewChatFailed: Could not start a new chat.
overviewDesignerNoConversation: Pick or start a chat first.
overviewStatusStale: Out of date vs current map
overviewDeleteConfirm: Remove the published layout? Browse will fall back to automatic layout.
overviewDesignerSubtitleA2ui: Chat to reshape the overview layout.
